Chapter XIII covers appeals, review and revision, including sections 161–164. act_title: Punjab Enforcement Of Women's Property Rights Act 2021
research_notes: Punjab Code lists both the Act and the Ordinance. The four-page Act PDF opens with a contents page identifying Act X of 2021, with the text dated 17 May 2021 on PDF page 2. Its purpose is to protect women's ownership and possession of property. Section 1 gives the short title as the Punjab Enforcement of Women's Property Rights Act 2021, extends it throughout Punjab, and provides for immediate commencement. Section 13 on PDF page 4 expressly repeals the Punjab Enforcement of Women's Property Rights Ordinance 2021 (IX of 2021). No subsequent amendment was identified on Punjab Code, and the PDF gives no consolidation cutoff.
